image_description: A close-up, macro photograph of a chiton (polyplacophore) clinging to a rocky substrate. The image highlights the dorsal surface, showing eight distinct, overlapping dark calcareous plates embedded in a thick, brownish, spiny/hairy girdle (mantle). The texture of the girdle appears rough and bristly, while the plates are smooth and segmented.
